program_name: Mac mini Service Program for No Power Issue
coverage_summary: Mac mini (2023, M2 chip) that won't turn on, made June to November 2024; free repair for 3 years from first sale
symptom: Mac mini may no longer power on
remedy: Service free of charge by Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider
mandatory_conditions: Device must be a Mac mini (2023) with the M2 chip (no other Mac mini models are part of this program)
Device serial number must be confirmed as eligible using Apple's serial number checker on the program page
Device will be examined prior to any service to verify that it is eligible for this program
Service must be obtained within three years after the first retail sale of the unit
exclusions_and_caveats: Any damage which impairs the ability to complete the repair will need to be resolved first; in some cases there may be a cost associated with the additional repair
Apple may restrict or limit repair to the original country or region of purchase
This program does not extend the standard warranty coverage of the Mac mini
The three-year window runs from the first retail sale of the unit, which may be earlier than your purchase date if the device was bought used or refurbished
